configurePresets.name: wasm-base
configurePresets.description: WebAssembly core. Configure through Emscripten: `emcmake cmake --preset wasm-release` (emcmake supplies the toolchain file). scripts/build-wasm.sh does this.

configurePresets.name: wasm-release
configurePresets.description: -O3 -flto, sized memory. Writes core.js and core.wasm into src/wasm/, where Vite bundles them.

configurePresets.name: wasm-debug
configurePresets.description: -O0 -g -sASSERTIONS=2, opt-in. Its own build and output directories so it can neither be mistaken for nor overwrite the release build; load it with CORE_WASM_DIR=cpp/build-wasm-debug/out.

configurePresets.name: native-base
configurePresets.description: The core as a plain static library, with the doctest unit tests.

configurePresets.name: native-asan
configurePresets.description: -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer. Finds heap overruns, use after free, leaks and undefined arithmetic that -sASSERTIONS=2 will not; a report aborts, so ctest fails on it.

configurePresets.name: native-tidy
configurePresets.description: Builds the core with clang-tidy (checks in .clang-tidy) and every finding an error.
